angle.description: Required original human angle (PRD R4, D-018).

closing_question.description: The SINGLE specific topical question the video ends on ('Which hour would you hand over first?'). Not engagement-begging (STYLE_GUIDE §9) — one question, one topic. build-metadata seeds the pinned comment from it (Phase 1.3).

pinned_comment.description: Optional authored pinned-comment text that ANSWERS the closing_question and invites replies ('Mine was copy-paste. What's yours?'). When omitted, build-metadata derives an invite from closing_question.

short_hook.description: Purpose-built opener for the Short. The Short no longer inherits the long-form hook: when present, make-short PREPENDS this as the Short's first scene so the first ~3s is authored for Short psychology ('Everyone thinks AI takes jobs. It doesn't.'). Respects one-continuous-audio — its narration is voiced as part of the Short's own TTS pass, never spliced from the long track.

narration.description: The Short's purpose-built opening spoken line(s) — its own cold-open, not the long-form intro.

sentences.description: Sentence split of narration (defaults to [narration] when omitted).

on_screen_text.description: The visual/caption punch shown over the first spoken line — preferred mechanism: a strong on-screen line distinct from the VO.

component.description: Optional bespoke hook-* component name (must start with 'hook' to satisfy the hook-class QA gate). When set the opener renders as a custom hero instead of a hook-card.
